## S1924 (2026-11-01): division-polynomial zero criterion proved via multiplication-by-n

File: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1924ZeroCriterionActual.lean`
Source SHA256 `93C8F9A00C2F74BBB97F24E48AE53FDE575A7E58BE3D5BCA737BED4D668929FE`,
build EXIT=0, olean SHA256 `7E406EC185DDD24E81DA8D40789EC56CE9960D4040E724942894C1DBD575E9E4`.
No sorry/axiom/opaque; #print axioms = propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

Result: the full group-law criterion
`n • P = 0 <-> W.evalDivisionPolynomialAtPoint n P = 0`
is proved for every field, every Weierstrass curve and every integer n
(`S1924Criterion_generic`), using S1626's universal formula
`s1626ZSMulPointEqSmulEval`.  This proves S1906's (b) `S1906ZeroCriterion`
(`S1924S1906ZeroCriterion`), the forward detection half, and the full
`S1906Criterion`.

Consequence: the S1906 basis gap no longer needs the x-coordinate formula (a)
or the zero criterion (b); it is now exactly the root count / separability of
`prePsi_l`:
`S1924S1906BasisGap_iff_rootCount`,
`S1924S1906BasisGap_iff_separable`,
`S1924S1906BasisGap_of_genericSeparable`.
The exact remaining input is (c) `S1906Separability l`
(equivalently `S1906RootCount l` / `S1366GenericOddPreΨSeparableInput`),
which is not proved here.  Report:
`coord/reports/S1924-zero-criterion-actual.md`.

## S1929 (2026-11-01): literal completion IQ carrier vs. S1902 root-extension carrier

File: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1929LiteralIQCarrierActual.lean`
Source SHA256 `D4BCC68B50F8812D26F9039CDD3591830099ACD089959B554AB745E02F943CD7`,
build EXIT=0, olean SHA256 `2073A08980DB517E35B055DDA96929BDD62D06EC7AD55786C67E4CE8BF6EA7B1`.
No sorry/axiom/opaque; #print axioms = propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

Result: the literal completion carrier
`LiteralCompletionIQCarrier T = (b) -> rootBase T b` is constructed, with the
actual canonical `Q`-linear embedding `completionToRootExtension T` into the
S1902 carrier `S1902Carrier T = (b) -> rootNormedExtension T b`.  The embedding
is injective but not surjective; its image `completionIQSubcarrier T` is a
proper `Q`-submodule.  At the positive theta label `j = 1` the S1902 theta
image is exactly the root family, and it is proved not to lie in the completion
image (`thetaImage_not_mem_completionRange`,
`thetaImageSet_not_subset_completionIQSubcarrier`).  The S1902
`IQHullLogVolumeInterface.imageSet` is therefore not contained in the completion
subcarrier.

The realization surface `LiteralIQCarrierRealization` (completion IQ hull
interface + completion theta image with the paper root equation + identification
with S1902) is proved uninhabited, both from the root equation and from the
theta-image compatibility.  The exact first missing is isolated as
`LiteralCompletionRootMissing T` (a completion `2l`-th root of the actual
`qVFamily` q at every bad place), and is equivalent to S342's
`TwoLthRootData`.  It is impossible by `twoLthRootData_impossible`.

Consequence: the ordinary-completion literal IQ carrier cannot be identified
with the S1902 root-extension carrier while preserving the actual theta image;
the gap is an S342-type completion-root obstruction, not a missing analytic or
Kummer estimate.  The paper K-side q_v/root remains a separate source object
(recorded in S424's `PaperKvQRootData`), not the repo qVFamily.

## S1943 — S1878EssSurj assembled from the representable two-pullback theorem (2026-11-01)

File: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1943AssembleEssSurjActual.lean` (compiles, EXIT=0; axioms
`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` only; SHA256 source
`35D8528E551C8A9A75B591091FB3F826286936B5DF7218E915F92D94AE5D92AF`, olean
`996F05A7AD9E5EE0505BF0EF2DC30CEBAB12DB67ECDF4B3C14459911228B7FC0`).

Result: `S1943EssSurj : S1878EssSurj` is proved, unconditionally, together with
`S1878Functor.IsEquivalence`, `S1878FunctorToSlice.IsEquivalence` and
`S1897ModelEssSurj`.  This closes the essential-surjectivity half of S1878 that
S1897/S1900 had left open.

What was actually used (no new hypothesis, no fake 2-cell/iso):

* S1911's *corrected* two-pullback theorem `S1911RepresentableTwoPullbackPullbackSquare`
  applied to the genuine scheme fibre product `T x_{Spec R'} C.carrier` of the cover
  structure map with a scheme-valued point `q~` of the orbicurve stack.  The 2-commutativity
  of the Yoneda square is built from the strict commutativity of the scheme square via the
  2-Yoneda comparison (`S1943PbCommutes`), not postulated.
* Transport of the presentation along the 2-Yoneda isomorphism `y(q~) ≅ q`
  (`S1943MovedPresentation`), so the result holds at *arbitrary* points `q`, not only at
  Yoneda points.
* `FiniteEtaleCover.finiteEtale_pullback` for finiteness/etaleness of the projection.
* Base change along the identity (`S1943PullbackAlongIdIso`) for the model: the
  identity-point projection is `pullback.snd (C -> Spec R') id`, and `Over.isoMk` of
  `pullback f 1 ≅ X` gives `S1816Obj A ≅ C`.

Explicitly *not* used: S1897's literal `S1897ExtensionData.idPresentation` equality
(`strong.toWeak.baseChange ... = S1897TrianglePresentation C`).  The identity-point model
is identified with `C` by an isomorphism, not by definitional equality.  Consequently
`S1897FirstMissing` (the literal form) is not proved and is not needed: the coherent cover
is `CoherentCover.ofStrong` of the strong structure constructed here.

Diagnosis recorded: the remaining input is not geometric.  Once the two-pullback statement
is corrected to a *pullback* square (S1911) and the point is handled by 2-Yoneda, the whole
inverse construction and `S1878EssSurj` follow formally.

Result: the literal completion carrier
`LiteralCompletionIQCarrier T = (b) -> rootBase T b` is constructed, with the
actual canonical `Q`-linear embedding `completionToRootExtension T` into the
S1902 carrier `S1902Carrier T = (b) -> rootNormedExtension T b`.  The embedding
is injective but not surjective; its image `completionIQSubcarrier T` is a
proper `Q`-submodule.  At the positive theta label `j = 1` the S1902 theta
image is exactly the root family, and it is proved not to lie in the completion
image (`thetaImage_not_mem_completionRange`,
`thetaImageSet_not_subset_completionIQSubcarrier`).  The S1902
`IQHullLogVolumeInterface.imageSet` is therefore not contained in the completion
subcarrier.

The realization surface `LiteralIQCarrierRealization` (completion IQ hull
interface + completion theta image with the paper root equation + identification
with S1902) is proved uninhabited, both from the root equation and from the
theta-image compatibility.  The exact first missing is isolated as
`LiteralCompletionRootMissing T` (a completion `2l`-th root of the actual
`qVFamily` q at every bad place), and is equivalent to S342's
`TwoLthRootData`.  It is impossible by `twoLthRootData_impossible`.

Consequence: the ordinary-completion literal IQ carrier cannot be identified
with the S1902 root-extension carrier while preserving the actual theta image;
the gap is an S342-type completion-root obstruction, not a missing analytic or
Kummer estimate.  The paper K-side q_v/root remains a separate source object
(recorded in S424's `PaperKvQRootData`), not the repo qVFamily.
